data.narrative:
CruxOCM is a Series A-stage climate and energy company founded by Roger Shirt and Vicki Knott that has raised $26.1M to date. The broader Climate & Energy sector comprises 9 private peers and 1 public comparable (Lonza, ticker LNZA), though a sufficiently narrow peer set at identical stage and valuation tier was not available to support median-based triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology was applied as the primary valuation anchor. Using total capital raised ($26.1M) as a proxy for current value and applying a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier for Series A advancement yields an implied valuation of $52M. This method is grounded in observed market practice for companies at this capital stage and funding round, though it assumes typical dilution and milestone achievement patterns.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $44M to $60M, with a median point of $52M. Key uncertainties limiting precision include the absence of sufficiently granular stage-matched comparables in the Climate & Energy sector and reliance on a single methodological approach. Sensitivity to the stage-multiplier assumption (here set at 2.0x) is material; tighter peer data or company-specific milestone evidence would reduce this range. Additional diligence on capital efficiency and pathway to Series B readiness would refine the upper and lower bounds.
